snippet.title: Secret Files: Tunguska – Remastered – From 4:3 to 4K Widescreen (Visual Upgrade Showcase)
snippet.description:
We’re bringing back the classic Secret Files: Tunguska — now remastered.

In this preview, we’re showcasing some of the visual improvements in the upcoming remaster — while staying true to the original atmosphere fans love.

One of the biggest challenges:
The original game was designed for 4:3 screens (1024×768).

For the remaster, we’re not simply upscaling these backgrounds —
we are carefully reworking and extending them by hand to support modern widescreen aspect ratios and resolutions, up to 4K (3840×2160).

This allows us to introduce:
- full widescreen support
- smooth camera scrolling
- subtle parallax effects and enhanced environmental depth

These features were never part of the original version, but now help bring the world of Tunguska to life in new ways.

We’re putting a lot of effort into preserving the original look — while carefully enhancing it where it truly adds value.

👉 Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4504840/Secret_Files_Tunguska__Remastered/
